resources.name: scorestream-format-index
resources.title: ScoreStream format versions and profiles
resources.description: Supported format versions/profiles and links to their normative grammar, language descriptor, AST schema, agent reference, and examples. score_get_format returns the concise authoring contract directly. This packaged manifest is a design example, not a live endpoint.

resources.name: scorestream-agent-reference-1.1
resources.title: ScoreStream 1.1 agent authoring reference
resources.description: The versioned syntax and semantic rules referenced by score_get_format. The supported profile is declared in the document.

resources.name: scorestream-grammar-1.1
resources.title: ScoreStream 1.1 EBNF grammar
resources.description: The raw SFS text grammar, separate from JSON Schema validation of a parsed AST.

resources.name: scorestream-language-1.1
resources.title: ScoreStream 1.1 machine-readable language standard
resources.description: The complete format descriptor, including syntax templates, vocabulary, semantic rules, and complete examples.

resources.name: scorestream-ast-schema-1.1
resources.title: ScoreStream 1.1 parsed AST schema
resources.description: JSON Schema 2020-12 for the parsed core AST; it is not a substitute for parsing SFS and semantic validation.

resources.name: scorestream-editing-contract
resources.title: ScoreStream editing contract
resources.description: Region selection, revision preconditions, atomic edits, idempotency, and boundary behavior for the deployed server.

resources.name: scorestream-capability-matrix
resources.title: ScoreStream capability matrix
resources.description: The deployed semantic, preservation-only, import, export, rendering, schema, and job capabilities. Future annotation and playback features are not advertised as available.
